title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #6 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When should you say the dua for leaving? (1 mark)
   A. As you step out of the door
   B. After meals
   C. When going to bed
   D. At night only

2. What does "tawakkaltu 'alallah" mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am tired
   B. I depend on Allah
   C. I am hungry
   D. I am happy

3. Which benefit comes when parents fulfil their duties? (1 mark)
   A. Children become unhappy
   B. No benefit
   C. Families become weak
   D. Children grow safe and well-behaved

4. What is muamalat? (1 mark)
   A. A journey
   B. The way people deal with each other
   C. A prayer
   D. A fast

5. Which is honest behaviour toward parents? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding
   B. Telling the truth and not hiding things
   C. Blaming others
   D. Lying

6. Even if parents command wrong, what should we do? (1 mark)
   A. Still treat them kindly in worldly matters
   B. Leave home
   C. Insult them
   D. Ignore them

7. Which is a way to help parents at home? (1 mark)
   A. Hide
   B. Break things
   C. Sweep and wash dishes
   D. Complain

8. Which shows disobedience? (1 mark)
   A. Slamming doors and refusing to help
   B. Greeting parents
   C. Helping with dishes
   D. Speaking softly

9. What did the Prophet say about the one who cuts family ties? (1 mark)
   A. He is rewarded
   B. He will not enter Paradise
   C. He is honoured
   D. Nothing

10. Which greeting is used with relatives? (1 mark)
   A. As-salamu alaykum
   B. Silence
   C. Shouting
   D. Insults

11. Why do we respect older relatives? (1 mark)
   A. They are rich
   B. They have experience and wisdom
   C. They are strong
   D. They are noisy

12. In which cave did the first revelation come? (1 mark)
   A. Hira
   B. Uhud
   C. Thawr
   D. Safa

13. Who did Khadija take the Prophet to for advice? (1 mark)
   A. Waraqa ibn Nawfal
   B. Ali
   C. Abu Talib
   D. Abu Lahab

14. Why is it hard to be among the first to believe? (1 mark)
   A. Few people believed and many opposed
   B. No one cared
   C. Everyone accepted
   D. It was easy

15. What did Abu Bakr do with his wealth? (1 mark)
   A. Refused to give
   B. Freed believers and supported Islam
   C. Wasted it
   D. Hid it

16. Who was the first Caliph? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Bakr
   B. Ali
   C. Uthman
   D. Umar

17. What did some people of Taif do as he left? (1 mark)
   A. Threw stones at him
   B. Cheered him
   C. Followed him
   D. Gave him food

18. Who travelled with the Prophet to Taif? (1 mark)
   A. Ali
   B. Abu Bakr
   C. Zayd ibn Haritha
   D. Bilal

19. To which town did the Prophet go to invite people to Islam about ten years after the first revelation? (1 mark)
   A. Habasha
   B. Cairo
   C. Taif
   D. Madinah

20. What is tolerance? (1 mark)
   A. Fighting
   B. Bearing with people who behave badly without hurting them
   C. Insulting
   D. Ignoring

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write the meaning of the dua for leaving the house. (3 marks)

22. State three ways Khadija (R.A.) helped the Prophet (S.A.W.). (3 marks)

23. Explain the hadith about keeping family ties and provision. (3 marks)

24. Suggest four situations in which a Grade 4 child needs patience, tolerance or perseverance. (4 marks)

25. Explain what Qur'an 17:23-24 teaches about treating parents. (3 marks)

26. Explain why the earliest converts are important. (3 marks)

27. Why is it important for parents to fulfil their obligations? (3 marks)

28. Write the meaning of the dua for entering the house. (3 marks)

29. Describe what happened when Jibril came to the Prophet in the cave. (3 marks)

30. Write the meaning of the first two verses of Surah Al-Alaq. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #6 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — As you step out of the door
   At the time of leaving.

2. B — I depend on Allah
   Tawakkul is trust in Allah.

3. D — Children grow safe and well-behaved
   Strong families.

4. B — The way people deal with each other
   Muamalat covers social relations.

5. B — Telling the truth and not hiding things
   Honesty.

6. A — Still treat them kindly in worldly matters
   Qur'an 31:15.

7. C — Sweep and wash dishes
   Helping is a duty.

8. A — Slamming doors and refusing to help
   Rudeness is wrong.

9. B — He will not enter Paradise
   A warning in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

10. A — As-salamu alaykum
   A Muslim greeting.

11. B — They have experience and wisdom
   Elders deserve respect.

12. A — Hira
   The cave of Hira.

13. A — Waraqa ibn Nawfal
   Waraqa knew earlier scriptures.

14. A — Few people believed and many opposed
   The first believers faced hardship.

15. B — Freed believers and supported Islam
   He bought and freed people.

16. A — Abu Bakr
   Abu Bakr led the Muslims after the Prophet.

17. A — Threw stones at him
   His feet were hurt.

18. C — Zayd ibn Haritha
   Zayd was his companion.

19. C — Taif
   He went to Taif.

20. B — Bearing with people who behave badly without hurting them
   He did not curse them.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might and no power except with Allah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three parts.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: She was first to believe, comforted him, supported him with wealth, stayed with him in hardship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Whoever wants his provision increased and life extended should keep good relations with relatives. Family ties bring blessing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the hadith idea, 1 mark for the two rewards, 1 mark for blessing.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Being teased, failing a test, a friend refusing to play, being sick, dealing with a rude neighbour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each suitable situation.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not say "uff", speak kindly, be humble and make dua for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of three teachings.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: They believed when it was hard, supported the Prophet morally and materially, and encouraged others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Children grow safe and well-behaved, the family and community are strong, and parents earn Allah's reward.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, and upon our Lord we depend.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the three parts.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jibril told him to read, he said he could not read, Jibril pressed him and repeated three times, then recited the first verses.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the command, 1 mark for reply, 1 mark for three times and recitation.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: Read in the name of your Lord who created; He created man from a clinging clot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verse.
